positive.description: Scan the review fixture for supported lifecycle risks
positive.prompt: Scan review-fixtures/demo for end-of-life runtimes, packages, and GitHub Actions.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the fixture's evidence-backed Node.js, request, and actions/checkout lifecycle findings with file locations.

positive.prompt: List every Evergreen deprecation in review-fixtures/demo and group the results by severity.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only findings supported by Evergreen's bundled registry and identify their severity and source files.

positive.prompt: Explain the request package finding in review-fixtures/demo, including its evidence and replacement.
positive.expected_behavior: Explain why request is deprecated, cite the bundled evidence URL, and recommend native fetch or a maintained client.

positive.description: Build migration context for a finding
positive.prompt: Create migration context for the request dependency finding in review-fixtures/demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the affected manifest and source usages, migration guidance, and reviewable verification suggestions without editing files.

positive.description: Verify that a resolved finding is absent
positive.prompt: Verify the actions/checkout finding after I update the fixture workflow to actions/checkout@v5.
positive.expected_behavior: Re-scan the fixture, confirm the original finding is absent, and report that no suggested commands were executed.
